text.text_excerpt: This place jams, because... A) The employees are all amazingly friendly and helpful. Special shoutout to my girl CANDY. She is so f'ing sweet and while ringing you up will tell you to go back and exchange some product for another one that's on sale, or tell you about sales that you might have missed so that you can get the best deal. B) They always have great sales. C) Winn-Dixie card. Gets me almost $1 off gas each time I fill my tank. D) Good wine selection, great tea selection, pretty good cheese selection, and carrying more and more vegetarian/vegan-friendly items. At great prices. E) Amazing parking, and open til midnight. MIDNIGHT! The ONLY bad thing is the very sad fresh produce se...

For the most part, this is my favorite Winn Dixie in the city because of its location to my house. It seems small and a bit lacking in the contents, but the people who work there are always amazing and helpful. Much like the other Winn Dixies, they're more affordable and have better coupons than the Rouse's up the street. The parking here is plentiful, and the store is always clean. They usually have whatever I'm looking for, except their area with baking supplies are spread out in an odd manner and I find myself spanning three aisles to find all of my baking ingredients, which just seems really odd. Over all, it's a solid store and the price is typically right. Is it the best WD ever? No...

I always go to Hollygrove Market and Farm to get my produce, then I come here to round out my groceries. The dry goods are always on a fair sale. Meats and dairy products are also good. My favorite part is the bakery section. Fresh hot bread! And hot apple pies ( and the pie is one of the best I've had)! The gas discount at Shell gas is also a nice bonus (They keep track of it through their Winn Dixie Card program.)
